data.one_liner: Pass a reactive data model down the widget tree and rebuild descendants when it updates.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Model class and ScopedModel widgets that allow developers to pass state down the widget tree. Descendant widgets automatically rebuild when the model notifies listeners of changes.
use_when: You want simple state management without complex boilerplate
You need to pass models down to specific descendants and rebuild them on changes
avoid_when: You are building a massive application that requires a robust scalable architecture
You prefer modern state management solutions with built-in dependency injection
strengths: Easy to learn and understand for basic state management
weaknesses: Can lead to deeply nested ScopedModel widgets in large apps
